title: AI-powered app maker Wabi pivots to a messaging experience
text: Wabi is repositioning its prompt-based app builder as a personal AI agent that can create interfaces on demand, combining chat, apps and ongoing tasks.

title: OpenAI launches Dots, its bubbly agentic avatar
text: Dots are meant to operate independent of any specific hardware or interface, pursuing user-defined goals continuously in the background with minimal oversight.

title: OpenAI launches GPT-6.1 Sol, says it nearly matches GPT-6 Astra and costs less
text: OpenAI says GPT-6.1 Sol delivers significant improvements over GPT-6 Sol across complex professional tasks, including code writing and debugging, document understanding, and executing multi-step business workflows.

title: OpenAI expands ChatGPT’s plugins with app-like interfaces and automations
text: OpenAI is expanding ChatGPT plugins with dedicated sidebar homes, interactive panels, file viewers, improved discovery, and support for automations.

title: OpenAI gives Codex reusable cloud environments that work across devices
text: OpenAI is expanding Codex with reusable cloud development environments, a revamped CLI with voice controls, new code review tools and a security-focused product for scanning repositories and preparing fixes.

title: Can a chatbot fix the government maze? The White House is about to find out
text: America.gov is intended to simplify the process of navigating government bureaucracy, but language models are imperfect and remain prone to hallucinations, which could cause new issues.

title: Instinct founder said more than 50% of transactions on the platform are travel-related
text: Instinct founder said the platform is growing 10% day by day, with transaction volume increasing at a similar rate.

title: Meta is expanding its AI agent Muse to small businesses
text: The tech giant says the agent can help owners run their business and find new customers.

title: OpenAI apologizes to Australia after its AI agents breached government sites
text: The company also detailed how some of those breaches had happened, and outlined additional measures it is taking to assess the impact of the events.

title: Reco raises $55M as AI agent security startups crowd the market
text: The round builds on a $30 million fundraise in February, taking the company's total funding to $140 million.

title: Anthropic’s prospectus details losses, growth, and, yes, a warning that its AI could end humanity
text: In its prospectus, Anthropic just told investors it's losing tens of billions of dollars a year, but also growing like crazy, and — oh yeah — its own AI might pose an existential risk to humanity.

title: Peak XV ups Surge seed investment ceiling to $5M, unveils 18-startup cohort
text: Thirteen of the 18 startups in Peak XV’s latest Surge cohort are targeting global markets, while more than half are based in India.

title: OpenAI reportedly ditches model over safety concerns
text: A top executive at the AI lab told the Wall Street Journal that the model in question had displayed a poor aptitude for following orders.

title: Source: Inference provider Modal Labs closing in on $750M round at $15.75B valuation
text: The new financing is expected to more than triples the AI infrastructure startup's valuation from just four months ago.

title: AMD will acquire Fei-Fei Li’s World Labs for $8.2 billion
text: The acquisition will see World Labs founder Fei-Fei Li join AMD as executive vice president and chief scientist.

title: Shopify opens checkout to browser-based AI agents
text: Shopify is expanding WebMCP support to checkout, allowing browser-based AI agents to update order details and complete purchases with a buyer’s authorization.

title: The AI boom took over Climate Week and not everyone is happy about it
